facts: The dataset covers 78 London fintech companies.
Combined total raised across 78 London fintech companies is £504.6m.
Nevis ranks first with £30.3m total raised.
The lowest value in the ranking is £2m (Ledger Rocket).
First place is 15.2 times the value of last place.
The top 10 hold 38.4% of the combined total (£193.5m).

Most common sectors. Data provision and analysis: 30 (38.5%), £209.5m combined; Payment processing: 21 (26.9%), £159.3m combined; Wealth, asset and investment management: 21 (26.9%), £154.4m combined; Budgeting and financial management: 19 (24.4%), £122.3m combined.

copy.title: Top 78 UK Seed-Stage London Fintech Companies
copy.h1: Top 78 UK Seed-Stage London Fintech Companies Ranked by Total Raised
copy.metaDescription: See which London fintech companies lead on total raised, with combined funding of £504.6m, a median of £4.5m, and sector and team size breakdowns.
intro: This page ranks 78 London fintech companies by total raised. It shows the combined total, the typical funding level and where the largest amounts sit across the group.
The ranking is a single snapshot of the dataset. It covers the leading companies, how funding is spread and the sectors and team sizes that appear most often.

sections.heading: Who leads the London fintech funding ranking
paragraphs: Nevis ranks first with £30.3m total raised. It develops an AI platform for wealth management. Januus.io ranks second with £27.9m and develops a cryptowallet-to-identity database that provides ownership data for cryptocurrency assets, wallets and transactions.
The top 10 hold 38.4% of the combined total, which is £193.5m. Only 4 of the 78 companies have at least £20m, and 13 have at least £10m.

sections.heading: Sector mix among London fintech companies
paragraphs: Data provision and analysis is the largest group by sector, with 30 companies, or 38.5%. These companies have a combined total raised of £209.5m. Payment processing and wealth, asset and investment management each have 21 companies.
Budgeting and financial management has 19 companies, or 24.4%, with a combined total raised of £122.3m.

sections.heading: Team sizes across the group
paragraphs: The 10-24 employee band is the largest group by team size, with 37 companies, or 47.4%. Those companies have a combined total raised of £203.4m.
Smaller teams also appear in the dataset. Companies with fewer than 5 employees number 10 and have a combined total raised of £49.8m.

sections.heading: How funding is spread across the ranking
paragraphs: The combined total raised across the 78 companies is £504.6m. The median is £4.5m, while the mean is £6.5m, which shows that a small number of larger totals lift the average above the middle value.
The lowest value in the ranking is £2m, held by Ledger Rocket. First place is 15.2 times the value of last place.
